mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "h_payment" (username, gym_id, installment, pay_price, pay_date, pay_name, data_id) VALUES (#{username}, #{gymId}, #{installment}, #{payPrice}, #{payDate}, #{payName}, #{dataId})
mapper.select: SELECT pay_id as payId, username, gym_id as gymId, installment, pay_price as payPrice, pay_date as payDate, pay_name as payName, data_id as dataId FROM "h_payment" ORDER BY pay_id DESC

SELECT d.data_id as dataId, d.contract, d.gym_id as gymId, d.sender_id as senderId, d.receiver_id as receiverId, d.receiver_name as receiverName, d.status, d.start_date as startDate, d.end_date as endDate, d.amount, d.quantity, d.issue_date as issueDate, d.signed_at as signedAt, d.manager_id as managerId FROM "h_contract_data" d WHERE d.sender_id = #{username} AND d.status = 'SIGNED' AND d.contract IN (3, 4) AND d.data_id NOT IN ( SELECT data_id FROM "h_payment" WHERE data_id IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY d.issue_date DESC, d.data_id DESC

SELECT settlement_id as settlementId, gym_id as gymId, commission, settled_at as settledAt, commission_rate as commissionRate, settle_month as settleMonth, status, expense_id as expenseId FROM "h_settlement" ORDER BY settlement_id DESC

SELECT settlement_id as settlementId, gym_id as gymId, commission, settled_at as settledAt, commission_rate as commissionRate, settle_month as settleMonth, status, expense_id as expenseId FROM "h_settlement" WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId}

SELECT expense_id as expenseId, gym_id as gymId, data_id as dataId, expense_name as expenseName, expense_date as expenseDate, expense_price as expensePrice, expense_rate as expenseRate FROM "h_expense" WHERE gym_id = (SELECT gym_id FROM "h_member" WHERE username = #{username}) ORDER BY expense_date DESC, expense_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "h_expense" (expense_id, gym_id, data_id, expense_name, expense_date, expense_price, expense_rate) VALUES (#{expenseId}, #{gymId}, #{dataId}, #{expenseName}, #{expenseDate}, #{expensePrice}, #{expenseRate})
mapper.select: SELECT p.gym_id as gymId, CAST(SUM(p.pay_price) * COALESCE( (SELECT c.contract_rate FROM "h_contract_data" c WHERE c.gym_id = p.gym_id AND c.contract = 1 AND c.status = 'SIGNED' ORDER BY c.signed_at DESC LIMIT 1), 0.10 ) AS int8) as commission, COALESCE( (SELECT c.contract_rate FROM "h_contract_data" c WHERE c.gym_id = p.gym_id AND c.contract = 1 AND c.status = 'SIGNED' ORDER BY c.signed_at DESC LIMIT 1), 0.10 ) as commissionRate FROM "h_payment" p WHERE p.pay_date >= #{startDate} AND p.pay_date <= #{endDate} GROUP BY p.gym_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO "h_settlement" (gym_id, commission, commission_rate, settle_month, status) VALUES (#{gymId}, #{commission}, #{commissionRate}, #{settleMonth}, '미지급')
mapper.select: SELECT d.data_id as dataId, d.contract, d.gym_id as gymId, d.sender_id as senderId, d.receiver_id as receiverId, d.receiver_name as receiverName, d.status, d.start_date as startDate, d.end_date as endDate, CASE WHEN d.contract = 1 THEN COALESCE( (SELECT CAST(SUM(p.pay_price) * d.contract_rate AS int8) FROM "h_payment" p WHERE p.gym_id = d.gym_id AND TO_CHAR(p.pay_date, 'YYYY-MM') = TO_CHAR(d.start_date, 'YYYY-MM')), 0 ) ELSE d.amount END as amount, d.contract_rate as contractRate, d.quantity, d.issue_date as issueDate, d.signed_at as signedAt, d.manager_id as managerId FROM "h_contract_data" d WHERE ( (d.sender_id = #{username} AND d.contract = 2) OR (d.receiver_id = #{username} AND d.contract = 1) ) AND d.status = 'SIGNED' AND d.data_id NOT IN ( SELECT data_id FROM "h_expense" WHERE data_id IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY d.issue_date DESC, d.data_id DESC
